records.text: “And you, take up a lament over Israel’s ruler,
and say: What was your mother? A cub! She came to be among lions; among lions she multiplied her cubs.
One of her cubs sprang away; he became a lion, learned to seize prey, and ate human beings.
and fire went out from a rod of her choice parts and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her. A tribe is for a parable of lament, and it will become a lament.”
And you will say this word to them: Bring tears down upon your eyes day and night, and let them not cease, because the daughter of My people was utterly crushed, with a very painful wound.
If I go out to the plain, behold, those wounded by the sword; and if I enter the city, behold, the pain of famine! For priest and prophet went to a land they did not know.
And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven in multitude, because you did not hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God.

And it shall be, as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so shall the Lord rejoice over you to destroy you; and you shall be removed from the land whither you go to inherit it.
Listen with your ears, and follow My ways; listen to Me, and your soul will live amid good things. And I will make with you an everlasting covenant: the holy and sure blessings of David.
Behold, I have given him as a testimony among the nations, a ruler and commander of nations.
Nations that did not know you will call upon you, and peoples that do not know you will flee to you for refuge, because of your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
Seek God, and when you find Him, call upon Him; and when He draws near to you,
But you, Israel, do not be ignorant; and Judah, do not enter Gilgal or go up to the house of On, and do not swear by the living Lord.
House of Judah’s king, hear the Lord’s word.

House of David, thus says the Lord: Judge a judgment in the morning, set things straight, and rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him, so that My anger is not kindled like fire and burns with no one to quench it.
Behold, I am against you who dwell in the valley of Sor, the level land, you who say, Who will frighten us? Or who will enter our dwelling?
And I will kindle a fire in her woodland, and it will consume everything around her.
Of David, when his land is being established. The Lord has become King! Let the earth exult; let many islands rejoice.
Cloud and gloom surround Him; righteousness and judgment are the establishment of His throne.
Fire will go ahead before Him and set His enemies aflame all around.
The Lord, Lord God Almighty, touches the earth and shakes it; all who dwell in it will mourn. Its consummation will rise like a river and descend like Egypt’s river.
He builds His ascent into heaven and establishes His promise upon the earth; He calls for the sea’s water and pours it upon the earth’s surface. The Lord God Almighty is His name.
For God will give rest upon this mountain, and Moab’s land will be trampled as people tread a threshing floor with wagons,
and he will release his hands, just as he himself brought low for destruction; he will bring low his insolence over what he laid his hands on,
and he will bring low the height of your wall’s refuge, and it will descend to the ground.
One who disciplines evil people will receive dishonor for himself, and one who reproves an impious person will bring blame on himself.
Do not reprove evil people, so that they may not hate you; reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Give a wise person a starting point, and he will be wiser; inform a righteous person, and he will receive still more.
You shall take a wife, and another man shall have her; you shall build a house, and shall not dwell therein; you shall plant a vineyard, and shall not gather its fruit.

Your calf shall be slaughtered before your eyes, and you shall not eat thereof; your donkey shall be seized from you, and shall not be restored unto you; your sheep shall be given unto your enemies, and there shall be none to help you.
Your sons and your daughters shall be given unto another nation, and your eyes shall look upon them and waste away; and your hand shall have no strength.
A nation which you do not know shall consume the yield of your land and all your labours; and you shall be wronged and crushed all your days.
You shall not pervert the judgment of a poor man in his cause.
You shall keep far away from every unrighteous charge; the innocent and the righteous you shall not kill, neither shall you justify the ungodly for gifts.
And you shall receive no gifts; for gifts blind the eyes of those who see, and corrupt righteous words.
For all things there is a time, and a season for every matter beneath heaven.
a time to give birth and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot what is planted,
a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to pull down and a time to build,
a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to beat the breast in mourning and a time to dance,
a time to throw stones and a time to gather stones, a time to embrace and a time to keep far from embracing,
a time to seek and a time to lose, a time to keep and a time to throw away,
a time to tear and a time to sew, a time to be silent and a time to speak,
a time to love and a time to hate, a time of war and a time of peace.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor what is evil; cling to what is good.
In brotherly love be tenderly devoted to one another; take the lead in honoring one another;
do not be slack in zeal; be fervent in spirit; serve the Lord;
rejoice in hope; persevere in affliction; persist in prayer;
share in the needs of the saints; pursue hospitality.
You shall appoint judges and recording officers for yourself in all your cities which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
They shall not pervert judgment, neither shall they show partiality, nor take a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise, and overthrow the words of the righteous.
You shall pursue justly that which is just, that you may live, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
